notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
description:
Activate Inkmoth Nexus's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Inkmoth Nexus's second ability by paying {1}, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to Inkmoth Nexus.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Inkmoth Nexus.
When the Inkmoth Nexus token enters the battlefield, Nissa and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Inkmoth Nexus token's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Repeat from step 6.
